segments.name: North America
segments.description: Sells Franklin Covey solutions to corporations, governments and not-for-profits in the United States and Canada.
segments.evidence: The Enterprise Division consists of our North America and International segments and is focused on selling our solutions to corporations, governments, not-for-profits, and other related organizations.

segments.name: International
segments.description: Serves Enterprise clients in other countries through wholly owned subsidiaries and independent licensee partners.
segments.evidence: The Enterprise Division consists of our North America and International segments and is focused on selling our solutions to corporations, governments, not-for-profits, and other related organizations.

segments.name: Education Division
segments.description: Sells Leader in Me membership, content and coaching to schools and colleges, including through international licensees.
segments.evidence: In our Education Division, we offer the Leader in Me membership, which provides access to the Leader in Me online service, and authorizes Education clients to use Franklin Covey's proprietary intellectual property.

revenueModel.text: Clients pay subscription fees for the All Access Pass and Leader in Me membership, plus fees for training and consulting services.
revenueModel.evidence: Subscription revenue includes sales of our All Access Pass and Leader In Me membership offerings including executive coaching and Education training and coaching days that are invoiced in one lump sum when contracted with a Leader In Me membership.

changes.text: In fiscal 2026, the Company changed its reportable segment presentation and recast prior period segment information to match.
